maintenance_led.reason: Sells water meters, ORION cellular AMI endpoints, sensors and BlueEdge software mainly for new installs and meter upgrade projects, not repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly municipal utilities funded by ratepayer water bills, plus commercial and industrial buyers; final payers are mostly not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own meters, BlueEdge and ORION products; UDlive is an occasional tuck-in acquisition.

mission_critical.reason: Meters and AMI endpoints are embedded in utility billing and network operations; switching means re-installation, software integration and accuracy and compliance risk.

notes: Utilities are often municipally owned, so the publicly_funded answer is somewhat uncertain.
